statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2) having exactly228 actual induced rook-nine vertex subsets counted once, set d_T=6-r_T for every actual triangle T. All d_T lie in{0,1,2}; if h counts deficiency-two triangles, then1<=h<=5 and exactly18-2h>=8 triangles have deficiency one. Every deficiency-two triangle has at most three deficiency-two defect partners across its three points; if it has three, then h=4. Thus at h=5 the deficiency-two defect graph has maximum degree two; if a degree-three node occurs, the graph is a three-leaf star or that star with one leaf edge. No count228 or target exclusion follows.
